notes: Read from the official 2026 publication listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.
DR 1098 (10/21/25): subtract $11,000 (married filing jointly or surviving spouse) or $5,500 (otherwise) from annual wages, multiply by 4.40%, divide by pay periods.

FAMLI: 2026 total premium 0.88% of wages up to the Social Security wage cap, split evenly (0.44% employee). Employers may choose to pay the employee share; the calculator assumes the employee pays it.
The Form DR 0004 certificate can replace the default allowance; it is not modelled. Colorado local occupational taxes are not included.
